methodology: Every factual claim comes from a page fetched in-session on the retrieval date above, with claim-level source URLs in the companion dossier (documentArtifact art_a1WB1gVA). Sources: official supplier websites first; export-promotion directories (ProColombia, PROMPERU, ProEcuador, ProChile, ApexBrasil) were discovery seeds only — no row rests on a directory page alone. Certifications are recorded only as stated on the supplier's own retrieved pages (status 'company-stated'); no certifier-database cross-check has been run this session. Fields without a fetched source are null; explicit unknowns stay unknown. Price signals are labeled by tier — quote-only is the honest default. No emails, phones, MOQs, prices, certifications, or reviews are invented. Dossier verification levels carry into the verification fields as: V1 (official site retrieved, detailed consistent claims) and V2 (official site retrieved but thin) both map to verificationLevel 'Official-site'; V2 rows carry confidence Medium (thin retrieval), V1 rows carry High or Medium exactly as the dossier rates them, with row notes preserving the dossier's thinness/self-reporting qualifiers.
